definition: An outlet counts as reputable if Wikipedia's Perennial Sources list rates it generally reliable; or, where Wikipedia has not rated it or rates it reliable only for some sections, topics or periods, if its Lin et al. (2023) aggregate quality score is above 0.66; or if it is an intergovernmental organization (.int domain or un.org). Outlets Wikipedia never rates generally reliable (no consensus, mixed, generally unreliable, deprecated, blacklisted) are excluded.

lin2023.title: Lin et al. (2023), High level of correspondence across different news domain quality rating sets, PNAS Nexus 2(9)
